subject: COBOL-WORDS directive
notes: GR1 'The content of each literal shall be processed as case-insensitive ... Any use of an equated or substituted literal shall be case-insensitive when used syntactically as a COBOL word' (cite.py OK §7.3.10.4 1)). Literal() upper-cases the content (ToUpperInvariant); CobolWordsMap dictionaries/sets are OrdinalIgnoreCase; the rewriter's synonym lookup is OrdinalIgnoreCase.
